handback.title: Commands become mentions of Dokima instead of slash words
handback.summary: Owners start Dokima by mentioning it with a verb, and every shipped text says so.
handback.feature: Owners talk to Dokima by mention and verb, get fixed replies on mistakes, and no shipped text names an old slash command.

stories.title: Mentions start Dokima's stages
stories.user_story: Owners start each stage by mentioning Dokima with a verb, and old slash commands still work.
stories.task: Route the mention and its verb, the bot name and the old forms.
stories.context: Today a command is the first word of a code owner's comment or PR review summary: `COMMANDS` and `autopilot_of` in `dokima/agent_roles.py` (around line 259) route `/plan`, `/work`, `/review`, `/autopilot start|stop`; `route()` is called by `python3 -m dokima.agent route` from the `route` job of `.github/workflows/commands.yml`, whose `if:` only lets bodies starting with `/` through, so it must also let `@` through. Keep the rule that the command opens the comment's first line, matched case-blind. The configured bot name is the settings' `bot.slug` (`dokima/defaults.yaml`, default `dokima-runtime`), exported as `BOT_SLUG` by `dokima/settings.py`. `stop` and `status` are new: the plan assumes stop cancels the issue's running agent run and status replies with the issue's stage (questions to the owner). `review` is not in the owner's verb table; the plan assumes it keeps today's behavior as a verb (question). Old slash commands keep routing for one version. A comment with no mention already starts nothing today, so its test must pair the bad case with a mention that does start something, or it passes today (#718). Edge cases normal use hits: a PR review summary, upper case, a mention not on the first line, a non-owner's mention.

stories.title: Fixed replies and where text after a command goes
stories.user_story: Owners get a fixed reply on a wrong command, and their text reaches the agent it is for.
stories.task: Post fixed replies and deliver prose to the right agent.
stories.context: Replies need a new path: `route` today prints only `role/stage/issue` or `autopilot/issue`; a reply line and a step in `.github/workflows/commands.yml` that posts it with the App token are new. No reply calls a model. No-prose commands: `autopilot stop`, `stop`, `status`. Prose: `owner_words()` in `dokima/agent_roles.py` already puts every code owner's comment in every pack (`owner_words.json`), so plan and work prose likely reach their agent today; the tests must prove the text lands in that agent's pack. Autopilot start prose must reach only the next agent: today `owner_words()` keeps it forever, so it must leave packs built after the next agent's record. Keep #738 in mind: comments with no mention stay the owner's words.

stories.title: Every shipped text names the mention, never slash commands
stories.user_story: Owners read only the mention form of commands, on cards, replies, prompts, rules and docs.
stories.task: Rewrite every old slash command in shipped files and add a scan test.
stories.context: Old forms found on main, outside tests: the workflows `agent.yml`, `autopilot.yml`, `commands.yml`; `dokima/agent_autopilot.py`, `agent_next.py`, `agent_records.py`, `agent_roles.py`, `card.py`, `playthrough.py`; `dokima/roles/planner.md`, `raising.md`; the rules files `board`, `commands`, `flow`, `raising`, `scope`, `specs`, `splitting`; `README.md`, `docs/index.html` and seven `docs/wiki` pages. `agent.py`, `planner.py`, `worker.md` and `reviewer.md` match only as paths (`dokima/planner.py`), so the scan must not flag paths. Past entries of `CHANGELOG.md` are history and stay. The scan must allow the one place the parser keeps the old forms for the migration. The owner names `dokima/card.py`, `dokima/roles/` and the workflows, so changing them is asked. The rules files describe the new grammar, including stop, status and the fixed replies.

raises.label: Stop is undefined
raises.text: What should the stop command stop? The plan assumes it cancels the agent run going on the issue.
raises.evidence: The issue's table lists stop with no target; `dokima/agent_roles.py` has no stop command today.

raises.label: Status is undefined
raises.text: What should the status command reply? The plan assumes the issue's stage, as its card shows it.
raises.evidence: The issue's table lists status with no reply text; no status command exists today.

raises.label: Review verb missing
raises.text: The verb table has no review. Should today's review command become a review verb? The plan assumes it does.
raises.evidence: `COMMANDS` in `dokima/agent_roles.py` holds `/review`; the table and migration name no review.
